status.label: Historical failure path replaced
status.detail: Merged #36215 removed WPFUI; the precise SystemThemeWatcher startup call in the 0.82.0 stack is absent from public main. Current-build behavior still needs verification.

next_action.label: Verify registry-denial behavior after WPF migration
next_action.reason: Validate the replacement path rather than patching a removed WPFUI call or claiming the open report is resolved.

reproduce.title: Compare historical and current Run theme initialization under denied registry access
reproduce.version_requirement: Historical 0.82.0/0.85.1 reference and latest stable or current main containing merged #36215
prerequisites: Isolated Windows 10 test account/environment; do not alter registry permissions on a real user's account.
A debugger or test seam capable of making the theme-preference read return access denied without changing unrelated registry access.
steps: Use the public 0.82.0 stack to identify the theme-preference read; reproduce its failure only in the isolated fixture, recording the exact key/operation rather than assuming the bot's unrelated registry reports match.
Confirm v0.82.0 MainWindow invokes SystemThemeWatcher.Watch and compare to the current MainWindow after #36215, where this call is absent.
Exercise current Run startup and a system theme change with a denied preference read, then test an explicitly selected Light/Dark theme.

If current Run still fails, capture the new originating stack and locate its current owner before designing any guard; otherwise record the tested build and reproduction conditions for a separate maintainer resolution decision.
reproduce.expected_result: Current Run remains usable or falls back safely under the restricted-theme fixture; no old WPFUI startup crash. This has not yet been executed.

judgment.rationale: The exact historical WPFUI initialization path has been replaced by a merged public migration. Treat this as existing relevant work pending behavior verification, not an assigned or proven-fixed issue.
evidence: The 0.82.0 stack throws SecurityException while WPFUI reads the system theme during PowerLauncher.MainWindow construction.
Duplicate #35928 reproduces the same WPFUI read during theme notification on 0.85.1.
Public main MainWindow.xaml.cs no longer contains SystemThemeWatcher.Watch; v0.82.0 does.
judgment.recommended_action: Verify denied theme-registry access against the replacement path before proposing a new fix or closing the issue.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged #36215 replaces the dependency and removes the exact startup call seen in the report. This is concrete coverage of the historical failing path, not an explicit issue-closing claim; access-denial behavior in the replacement path remains untested.

issue_context.summary: Run crashed on Windows 10 when WPFUI could not read a theme registry value. A later duplicate shows the same dependency failing during a theme-change notification.
known_information: The report provides the complete SecurityException startup stack, PowerToys 0.82.0 and Windows build 19045.
#35928 was explicitly closed as a duplicate and supplies a matching WPFUI stack on 0.85.1.
The issue remains open, labeled Issue-Bug/Product-PowerToys Run, with no assignee.
#36215 merged on 2024-12-11 and replaces WPFUI with native .NET WPF.
inferences: Replacing WPFUI removes the exact throwing dependency path, but does not prove that all current registry-denial cases recover safely.
The other registry-access issues suggested by the bot concern different operations and are not sufficient duplicate evidence.
issue_context.analysis: The stack already identifies the historical failure boundary, so a generic request for another ZIP adds little. Verify current restricted-theme behavior and only design a new guard if a current failing path exists.
initial_investigation: Read the full report and bot comment, enumerated cross-references, and read #35928's report and duplicate decision.
Read the public body/state of merged #36215.
Compared public v0.82.0 and main src/modules/launcher/PowerLauncher/MainWindow.xaml.cs: SystemThemeWatcher.Watch is present only in the historical version.
No runtime registry-denial test was performed in this lightweight pass.

information_gaps.information: Whether a current build survives the equivalent denied theme-preference read and theme-change notification.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines whether the dependency replacement resolves the report or a new current-path fix is required.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Maintainer runs the isolated registry-denial reproduction above and records build and originating stack; do not ask the reporter to change registry ACLs.
